title: OpenAI's Mobile Codex Bet
caption: OpenAI's Codex is heading to your phone, promising a new era of mobile development. This isn't just a port; it's a re-think of on-the-go coding, offering unprecedented workflow flexibility directly from your device. Tap the link in bio to BUILD for the field guide.

slides.headline: Your phone is now a *dev station*. OpenAI just made it real.
slides.sub: Codex goes mobile, changing how you build.

slides.definition: An AI model from OpenAI, fine-tuned for code generation and understanding natural language prompts to write code.
slides.example: Turns 'make a button that says hello' into functional JavaScript.

slides.title: Why Mobile, Why Now?
slides.body: OpenAI is pushing Codex beyond desktop IDEs. Expect on-the-go code edits, rapid prototyping, and bug fixes directly from your device, enhancing workflow flexibility.

slides.title: New *Flexibility* for Developers
bullets: Test simple scripts without a full setup.
slides.footer: The goal: remove friction from the dev loop.

audiences.body: Quick iterations, immediate problem-solving, reduced reliance on a dedicated workstation.
Rapid diagnostics and patches for critical systems when away from the desk.
Experiment with code concepts and get instant feedback without a complex environment.

slides.title: Not Without *Challenges*
bullets: Security concerns for sensitive code on personal devices.
slides.footer: Mobile convenience versus practical development needs.

slides.sub: Get Flowi's insights on the next wave of AI development.
